title: The Bark Mask
text: A face has grown into the bark of an old oak, eyes half lidded, mouth knotted shut. It follows the party as you pass, turning in the wood with a creak. It will let the most unseeing of you borrow its eyes, it whispers, for a little while.

options.label: The poorest eye borrows the oak's eyes.

outcomes.text: They see every root and snare in the wood, and every path through it.
They see what the wood sees, and the wood is hungry, and it has been looking at all of you.

options.label: The strongest cuts the face out of the tree.

outcomes.text: The wood screams, every tree at once. The mask is fine work, and its eyes stay shut.

options.label: Nod to it, as to a neighbour, and pass.

outcomes.text: The face creaks into something like a smile, and the branches part a little.
